title: Post-demo: benchmark sprint and burst capacity agreement
text:
Post-demo: benchmark sprint and burst capacity agreement

["From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Park <simon@luminate.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed benchmark sprint

Hi Simon —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I loop in procurement: 

Summary from our discovery
- Primary workload: real-time document summarization + Q&A over 1–5k token contexts (customer docs).
- Target SLA: p95 < 200ms, p99 < 350ms for single-turn queries at 512 tokens.
- Success criteria: (1) fidelity on your internal eval set (ROUGE/Lexical match benchmarks TBD), (2) sustained throughput of 8–12 req/s at peak within latency SLOs, (3) end-to-end cost per 1k tokens inside agreed threshold (we can draft).

Proposed POC (2-week benchmark sprint) — high level
- Dates: July 10–24 (we can shift based on procurement).
- Redwood scope: provide a dedicated trial environment, reserved capacity for baseline runs, and a shared evaluation harness (we'll run representative workloads).
- Luminate scope: provide a 5–10k sample corpus, evaluation prompts, and a small set of priority queries for latency/throughput tests.

Capacity proposal (initial)
- Reserved GPUs: 4x A100 80GB (reserved for the two-week sprint).
- Autoscaling policy: baseline pool of 2 worker nodes, can scale up to 6 nodes automatically based on queued request backpressure.
- Burst expectations: allow short bursts (up to 12 nodes) using preemptible capacity for 1–2 minute windows during scheduled stress tests — cold start behavior will be measured during first run.

Next steps / asks for you
1) Confirm the proposed sprint dates or suggest alternatives.
2) Share the sample corpus + evaluation prompts (S3 or Drive link).
3) If procurement needs formal SOW or PO before July 10, tell me and I will route the SOW draft (attached) to procurement.

I attached a first-pass SOW and the baseline benchmark CSV we mentioned. Neha — could you confirm the burst QoS profile and expected warmup time for the KV cache? Evelyn — can you call out the telemetry hooks we need from Luminate to correlate traces?

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0190
Attachment(s): luminate-poc-sow-v1.pdf
", "From: Simon Park <simon@luminate.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@luminate.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed benchmark sprint

Ben —

Appreciate the thorough recap. High level — Luminate is excited to move ahead. Quick answers and clarifications: 

1) Dates: July 10–24 work for the core team. We do have a holiday week for several engineers July 17–19; if we can front-load the heavier bench runs July 10–16 that'd be ideal.

2) Corpus: I'll share a redacted sample (S3 link) by EOD tomorrow. We'll include the evaluation prompts and an expected rubric.

3) Procurement: we typically need a signed SOW + PO to allocate budget. Please send SOW and a simple payment term template (.pdf) — I'll get procurement to confirm by July 8.

Capacity questions from our infra folks (they asked me to clarify):
- Is the 4x A100 80GB reserved for the whole sprint or sized for single-region throughput testing?
- For burst to preemptible instances — do you have an estimate for cold-start latency impact on first request after scale-up?

I'll loop in procurement as requested.

Thanks,
Simon
Head of ML Infrastructure
Luminate Analytics
", "From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Park <simon@luminate.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed benchmark sprint

Simon —

Short answers from an SRE/serving perspective: 

- Reserved capacity: Yes, we recommend 4x A100 80GB for the baseline sprint when your evaluation includes long contexts (1–5k tokens). That gives a steady-state throughput of ~10–14 concurrent 512-token requests depending on model choice and quantization. If you plan to run multi-turn/long-chaining evals, call that out and we may bump to 6x.

- Burst and cold-start: Preemptible nodes are added for burst windows; typical cold-start (container + model load) is 25–90s depending on model size and warm cache. For user-experience-sensitive tests we'd recommend running a warmup pass (single warmup wave) before measuring p99. We'll document warmup steps in the runbook.

- Autoscaling profile (suggested):
  * min_nodes: 2 (reserved)
  * scale_to: 6 (automatic) based on tail-latency triggers
  * burst_limit: 12 (preemptible) for scheduled stress runs only
  * cooldown: 90s

I'll attach a short runbook snippet and the telemetry keys we need (trace/span correlation id, request_id, token_count).

Neha Kapoor
Solutions SRE
Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): baseline-benchmarks.csv
", "From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Park <simon@luminate.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@luminate.ai
Date: 2028-07-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed benchmark sprint

Thanks Neha — and Simon, attaching the SOW with payment terms. A few pragmatic suggestions so procurement can proceed with minimal back-and-forth: 

- SOW highlights: 2-week dedicated trial, 4x A100 reserved, autoscale and burst as described, deliverables include (1) benchmark report, (2) runbook, (3) go/no-go recommendations.
- Billing: we can accept a PO for the reserved sprint amount; add-on burst usage will be invoiced post-sprint with line items.
- Cancellation: 7-day notice to avoid reserved-slot charges.

Evelyn — can you confirm the list of telemetry keys we need from Luminate (Neha called out the basics) and whether we need a lightweight agent or just headers?

Simon — once procurement confirms PO timeline we'll lock the reservation. If you want, we can also schedule a short 30-min pre-warm run with your infra the morning of July 10.

—
Ben
Attachment(s): luminate-poc-sow-v1.pdf
", "From: Simon Park <simon@luminate.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@luminate.ai
Date: 2028-07-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed benchmark sprint

All —

This looks good. Procurement confirmed they should have PO approved by July 8 with the terms in your SOW. We'll proceed with July 10–24 window and front-load the heavier runs to July 10–16 as requested.

Simon — for infra clarity: we will provide the corpus S3 link by EOD tomorrow and the adoption team will schedule the pre-warm session on the 10th at 09:00 PT.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the sprint.

--
Simon Park
Head of ML Infrastructure
Luminate Analytics
"]
